title: Secret US Air Force plane landed without Brazilian authorization

tellings.quote: Because they landed without the authorization of the Brazilian government. It was a secret mission and it was a US Air Force plane.

plain: In 1996, around the events at Varginha, a town in Brazil, a US Air Force plane is said to have landed on a secret mission without the Brazilian government's permission. The documentary filmmaker James Fox tells Michels this as what he was told by someone he interviewed. If true, it would mean the United States quietly sent its own military into whatever happened at Varginha.
